interactions.note: The structure of the LINGO-1/Li81 Fab ectodomain complex was solved to 3.23 Å resolution by molecular replacement. The antibody was shown to bind to the convex surface of the leucine-rich repeat domain of LINGO-1 within repeats 4-8. Fab binding blocks contact points used in the oligomerization of LINGO-1 and produces a stable complex containing 2 copies each of LINGO-1 and Fab that results from a rearrangement of contacts stabilizing the quaternary structure of LINGO-1. There is a single copy of the LINGO-1/Li81 Fab complex in the asymmetric unit.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.23 angstroms
